title: Current loans with at least one missed payment
prompt: Which loans are still marked 'current' (not yet defaulted or paid off) but already have at least one missed payment? These are the at-risk current loans.
population: Loans with status = current, checked against their loan_payments.
transformationPlan: find which of those loans have at least one missed payment
referenceSql: SELECT l.customer_id, l.loan_id, l.principal FROM loans l WHERE l.status = 'current' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan_payments lp WHERE lp.loan_id = l.loan_id AND lp.status = 'missed')

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT l.customer_id, l.loan_id, l.principal FROM loans l JOIN loan_payments lp ON lp.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE l.status = 'current' AND lp.status = 'missed'
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Works but produces one row per missed payment instead of one row per loan — a loan with 2 missed payments shows up twice, breaking the stated grain.
